name: @hobo/provider-oci-registry
description: HoBo generic OCI distribution registry realizer (oci-registry.image/v1): converges an image or index at a repository by digest plus declared tags on GHCR, Docker Hub, ECR, Artifact Registry, Harbor or Zot over the core ResourceResolver port, with cross-repository mount or verified blob upload, manifest PUT by digest, declared-tag PUT, referrers copy, the WWW-Authenticate bearer token flow and observation-confirmed, digest-preserving convergence (D22).
